evidence: The film thickness and surface morphology were evaluated by high-resolution scanning electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy (AFM), respectively. The x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra were measured using a Shimadzu XRTOS-XSAM 800 x-ray photoelectron spectrometer. The crystallographic structure of the deposited films was examined by a Rigaku RINT 2000 x-ray diffractometer.
